what: A cell folded to 0 width between the two big name words opens in .85s on hover (the side gaps too), and the round photo plate inside grows from .6x in .9s and appears at .26s — the photo in the plate settles from 1.14x in 2.1s, and the two words are pushed apart by ±.025em. All curves are cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1). On release it folds back over the same duration. Touch screens don’t open it.

options.--fx-open: Open cell width, default 1.9em — original clamp(145px, 12vw, 225px)
options.--fx-space: Gap on both sides of the open cell, default .22em — the original is clamp(12px, 1.4vw, 26px)
options.--fx-frame-w · --fx-frame-h: Photo panel size, default 1.5em · 1.75em — original clamp(115px, 9vw, 175px) · clamp(135px, 10.5vw, 205px)
options.--fx-gap-h: Collapsed cell height (affects line height), default 1.2em — original clamp(110px, 8vw, 155px)
options.--fx-dur: Length the slots spread apart, default .85s
options.[data-fx-part=word] + [data-fx-part=gap]: Leading word · cell · photo panel (one photo inside) · trailing word

use: ProcedureName
note: The original hides the column entirely at 681px and below and wraps names onto multiple lines — that is the consumer’s media query job

from.where: index.html .treatments__title — original TrattamentiPageIndex treatment name line (Implant·[photo]·ologia)
